name: Grilled chicken
summary: Free-range chicken, raised on natural feed and grilled in the mountain style, is the plate Mang Den is known for. It comes with cơm lam, sticky rice cooked in bamboo.
origin: Mang Den, where food comes fresh off the farm or the garden.
culture: Mang Den cooks from the farm and the garden, and this grilled chicken has become the town’s signature dish.
howToEat: Order the chicken with cơm lam. The weekend market sells the two together as gà nướng cơm lam.
At the town’s cultural night, gà nướng is served with cơm lam, pork skewers, bánh nếp, and rượu cần.
where: Chợ phiên Măng Đen, the weekend market, meets on Saturday and Sunday on the pine hill along Hùng Vương. Báo Kon Tum also places it in the pine garden (Vườn thông) by the district central square.
The cultural night at Không gian văn hóa “Thiên đường Tây Nguyên- Măng Đen”, held after a race opening on the afternoon of 6 January.
seoTitle: Grilled chicken in Mang Den — gà nướng cơm lam
seoDescription: Free-range chicken grilled in the mountain style, with sticky rice cooked in bamboo: the plate Mang Den is known for.
